(content-scraper must invoke ArxivAdapter.fetch_content implemented in scraper package | contract surface: services/scraper/app/adapters/arxiv.py:ArxivAdapter.fetch_content | content-scraper cannot scrape without cross-package import or duplicate adapter code | content-scraper service, ArXiv fetch_content)
```

**Surface 2** · confirmed
```
(manifest poll atomic claim RELEVANCE_PASSED→SCRAPE_QUEUED | contract surface: services/state-worker/app/transitions.py:MANIFEST_CLAIM_MAP | double-processing if content-scraper bypasses poll or polls wrong state | content-scraper loop)
```

**Surface 3** · confirmed
```
(adapter failure envelope vs state-worker failure POST — two retry layers | contract surface: §6.3 RETRIABLE_HTTP + POST /entries/failed is_retriable | wrong is_retriable flag breaks retry sweep vs escalation routing | failure reporting)
```

**Surface 4** · confirmed
```
(Docker image tag bishop/content-scraper:m0 | contract surface: docker-compose.yml + tests/test_compose.py | M4 exit gate compose test fails if tag not bumped | milestone gate)
```

**Surface 5** · suspected
```
(PYTHONPATH collision if content-scraper and scraper both use top-level package name app in one image | contract surface: services/content-scraper/Dockerfile PYTHONPATH | import shadowing breaks adapter imports or worker main | content-scraper Docker layout)
```
Disproven by: Dockerfile uses distinct package roots (e.g. worker `app/` + vendored `scraper_app/` or single-root layout documented in T2 decision log).

**Surface 6** · confirmed
```
(provenance fields on manifest required before Entry creation | contract surface: assert_pre_filter_provenance + POST /entries/content | 409 provenance_incomplete if M3 provenance missing; integration must seed profile_version/batch_id/rationale | provenance verification, integration gate)
